rules.title: Ordinary private-company accounts
rules.summary: 9 months after year end; excludes first and special periods

rules.title: Corporation Tax return
rules.summary: 12 months after CT accounting-period end; applicability must be established

rules.title: Corporation Tax payment
rules.summary: 9 months and 1 day; not the instalment regime

rules.title: Self Assessment ordinary filing dates
rules.summary: Tax-year-specific deadlines; notice-specific deadlines may override

rules.title: MTD Income Tax rollout
rules.summary: 2026: over 50000 using 2024–25 income; 2027: over 30000 using 2025–26; 2028: over 20000 using 2026–27; exemptions and existing mandation require review

rules.title: MTD cumulative standard updates
rules.summary: Cumulative updates due 7 August, November, February and May; calendar elections not implemented

rules.title: Micro nominal annual size thresholds
rules.summary: Threshold lookup only; exclusions, two-year rules, transition and prorating not implemented

rules.title: Replacement revised accounts completeness
rules.summary: Preserve period; approval dates and full replacement including P&L; not a complete legal or iXBRL validator

rules.title: Confirmation statements
rules.summary: Review period, filing deadline, director identity links and fees are separate fields

rules.title: Director and PSC identity verification
rules.summary: Role-specific dates and personal codes; not company authentication codes

rules.title: Mandatory software accounts filing
rules.summary: April 2028 software filing announced; general P&L publication reform paused

rules.title: FRS 102 and FRS 105 periodic review
rules.summary: Principal effective date periods beginning 1 January 2026; framework-specific transition

rules.title: Corporation Tax rates and marginal relief
rules.summary: Rate and threshold conditions, associated companies, augmented profits, exclusions and period apportionment

rules.title: VAT registration
rules.summary: Rolling taxable turnover and forward test; non-established rules differ

rules.title: VAT digital records and returns
rules.summary: All VAT-registered businesses unless exempt; digital links required where applicable

rules.title: Payroll RTI
rules.summary: FPS normally on or before payday; EPS and payment deadlines separately determined

rules.title: Construction Industry Scheme
rules.summary: Monthly return, verification, status declaration and deductions; due 19th following tax month

rules.title: LLP accounts and tax
rules.summary: Company-style accounts obligations and partnership/member tax workflows

rules.title: Partnership returns
rules.summary: Nominated partner and partner allocations; partnership MTD commencement not announced

rules.title: CIC annual report
rules.summary: CIC34 with accounts; dedicated package and revision routes

rules.title: England and Wales charities
rules.summary: Legal form, income, accounts basis, scrutiny and charity regulator reporting

rules.title: Scottish charities
rules.summary: OSCR annual reporting normally within 9 months; charity company may have dual obligations

rules.title: Northern Ireland charities
rules.summary: Annual monitoring return within 10 months for relevant year

rules.title: Registered societies
rules.summary: AR30 and accounts within 7 months; society category and jurisdiction matter

rules.title: Trust and estate returns
rules.summary: SA900 and relevant supplementary pages; TRS separate

rules.title: Unincorporated associations
rules.summary: Corporation Tax may apply without Companies House registration

rules.title: UK property disposals
rules.summary: Separate 60-day reporting/payment triggers and non-resident reporting

rules.title: Annual Tax on Enveloped Dwellings
rules.summary: Separate annual/event deadlines and relief declaration returns

rules.title: Software provider versus paid tax adviser
rules.summary: Software provision exemption does not establish exemption for managed agent services

rules.title: AML service classification
rules.summary: Automated accountancy/tax services can still be in scope

rules.title: Companies House authorised agents
rules.summary: Identity verification and filing-as-agent rules differ; confirm commencement at launch

rules.title: HMRC production qualification
rules.summary: API testing, headers, terms and production access are separate release gates

rules.title: HMRC taxonomy acceptance windows
rules.summary: Separate accounts and computational taxonomy versions; acceptance is not correctness

rules.title: Consumer subscription reform
rules.summary: October linked guidance is explicitly draft; do not treat proposed dates as commenced law

rules.title: Privacy by design
rules.summary: UK GDPR, DPA 2018 and commenced DUAA changes; distinguish controller/processor roles

rules.title: Corporation Tax accounting-period length
rules.summary: No more than twelve months; longer accounts can require two returns

rules.title: Corporation Tax amendments
rules.summary: Usually within twelve months of the filing deadline; later routes differ

rules.title: Annual investment allowance
rules.summary: Nominal AIA 1 million; period adjustment, restrictions and other allowances require separate calculations

rules.title: England/Wales charity September 2026 threshold changes
rules.summary: Apply by year END on/after 30 September 2026 and legal form; do not reuse older thresholds or apply to all UK charities

rules.title: Charities SORP 2026
rules.summary: Reporting periods starting on/after 1 January 2026; jurisdictional enabling regulations and sector SORPs matter
